Leading the way for
Almost 50 years
Founded in 1973, Manfreight has been leading the way in transport and logistics for 50 years. In that time, we've grown from a single truck to a fleet of more than 250 state of the art vehicles, serving some of the world's biggest brands.

LEADING THE WAY in Transport and Logistics FOR ALMOST 50 YEARS
Established in 1973, Manfreight is a leading privately owned logistics company within Ireland. With its headquarters in Craigavon and strategically located sites throughout Ireland and the UK, it is able to offer levels of service that are second to none. Manfreight services include Irish, UK and European transport, logistics and food grade logistics solutions. With extensive sector specific experience of ambient, chilled and frozen foods. Manfreight provide efficient, flexible logistics solutions with high levels of client care to the food and beverage sector.
Working within their customers’ supply chains, Manfreight provide seamless temperature controlled logistics solutions, handling and storing food goods safely and according to best practice on behalf of their clients. Their chilled, frozen and ambient client base is diverse and includes numerous retail distribution centres (RDCs).
The key to success of Manfreight operating within the food sector and beverage sectors, is speed to market combined with scalability and highly bespoke levels of service.
The company’s roots stretch back more than four decades.
In recent times, we have invested close on £1m in our County Armagh hub, while a new depot in Lancashire will enable us to enhance our service and support to customers throughout the UK.
